recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-panel grid composition featuring grayscale portraits and action shots set against a backdrop of vibrant, saturated color blocks. The design utilizes a 'scrapbook' or 'street collage' style with rough, jagged borders, halftone patterns, and a central heraldic shield element containing bold typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Grayscale photography versus high-saturation background colors
Rigid grid structure versus organic, torn-paper edges
Centralized typographic anchor versus peripheral character studies
coreInvariants: A 3x4 or 4x4 grid layout with a central focal point
Heavy use of primary and secondary colors (purple, yellow, red, green)
Black and white or high-contrast desaturated photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple small-scale subjects occupy individual grid cells, while a larger graphic shield occupies the center-top position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central purple shield containing the primary title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central shield and radiates outward to the surrounding grid cells, following the high-contrast color shifts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'busy', utilizing every cell for visual information.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Purple (background grid and central shield)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow and Red (background panels and accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements creates a stark contrast against the mid-tone grayscale photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to solid, punchy color blocks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Wide, extended slab serif with thick horizontal strokes
Bottom line: Condensed, tall sans-serif with uniform stroke weight
White fill with thin dark outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphen in the center name is elongated to match the width of the characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, authoritative slab serif paired with a taller, energetic condensed sans-serif for vertical contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the main title.
Matches the wide slab serif used for the top line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 3x4 grid of square panels. Each panel should have a different vibrant solid color (purple, yellow, red, green). Inside each panel, place a high-contrast grayscale photo of a person in an action pose or portrait. Apply a 'torn paper' or 'jagged edge' effect to the borders of each panel. In the center, place a large purple shield shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text with a thin black outline inside the shield. The top line should be a wide slab serif; the bottom line should be a tall, condensed sans-serif. Center the text perfectly within the shield.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a white fill and black outline?

adjustableVariables: Shape of the central anchor (shield, circle, star)
Intensity of the torn edge effect
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Clean typographic legibility despite busy background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no two adjacent panels have the same background color.
Verify that the torn edges look organic and not repetitive.
Check that the grayscale photos have deep blacks and bright whites.
Confirm the typography is centered and legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rigid grid of vibrant color blocks with desaturated photography and a central graphic anchor containing bold, outlined display type.
